There’s still no slider for recently added, only on the default homepage, which makes photos and videos I save from social media end up out of order. The slider on recently added only scrolls a little at a time compared to the defualt page being able to jump months or years. On iPhone the video player is buggy too. The play button keeps showing on loops and they stutter instead of playing smooth. Android finally got the slider back but iPhone is still waiting. I already back everything up with another service, but it’s frustrating that Google ignores feedback. It’s been years with no simple improvements. Same with YouTube Music.
